title: The whole line is the whole
statement: On a number line the fraction refers to the whole line drawn, so 1/2 is at the middle of the line wherever the line ends.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: place a fraction on a number line longer than one unit
evidence_patterns.signature: places the fraction at that fraction of the whole drawn segment rather than of the unit interval

example.item: Mark 1/2 on a number line from 0 to 3
example.response: at 1 1/2, the middle of the line

evidence_patterns.notes: On a 0-to-2 line the two placements for 1/2 differ (1/2 vs 1); on 0-to-1 they coincide, so 0-to-1 lines cannot detect this belief.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: read the fraction shown by a point on a number line longer than one unit
evidence_patterns.signature: reports the point's position as a fraction of the drawn line

example.item: A point is at 1 1/2 on a line from 0 to 3. What number is it?

discriminators.vs_slip: Correct on 0-to-1 lines and wrong on longer lines, consistently. A slip has no such dependence on line length.

vs.math.frac.two-whole-numbers: Learners who see a fraction as two whole numbers fail 0-to-1 lines too, placing 3/4 at 3 or 4.

conflicts_with.label: CCSS 3.NF.A.2: understand a fraction as a number on the number line

resolved_by.label: CCSS 3.NF.A.2: understand a fraction as a number on the number line
CCSS 3.NF.A.1: understand a fraction 1/b as one part of a whole partitioned into b equal parts

sources.citation: Bright, G. W., Behr, M. J., Post, T. R., & Wachsmuth, I. (1988). Identifying fractions on number lines. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education, 19(3), 215-232.
sources.note: Number-line tasks: students using the whole line rather than the unit interval.

sources.citation: Hart, K. M. (Ed.). (1981). Children's Understanding of Mathematics: 11-16. John Murray. (Concepts in Secondary Mathematics and Science project.)

provenance.notes: Drafted from the cited literature for the OML seed pack; statement, examples and discriminators are original text. Awaiting maintainer review.
